definition: 退款/退货指标以 orders 和 payments 表为主，退款订单指 orders.status = 'refunded'。

metrics.name: 退款率
metrics.sql_template: COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM orders

metrics.name: 退款手续费
metrics.sql_template: SUM(amount) - SUM(refund_amount) FROM payments WHERE refund_amount > 0
